paper_title: 18.63% Efficiency of Ternary Organic Solar Cells Achieved via Nonhalogenated Solvent and Hot Spin-Coating Process
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Adv Funct Materials - 2024 - Huang - 18 63  Efficiency of Ternary Organic Solar Cells Achieved via Nonhalogenated Solvent/auto/Adv Funct Materials - 2024 - Huang - 18 63  Efficiency of Ternary Organic Solar Cells Achieved via Nonhalogenated Solvent.md

knowledge_points.content: The ternary PM6:BTP-BO-4F:GS-ISO organic solar cell achieved a maximum power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 18.63% when processed with o-xylene, featuring an open-circuit voltage (VOC) of 0.865 V, a short-circuit current density (JSC) of 27.55 mA cm⁻², and a fill factor (FF) of 78.19%.
knowledge_points.evidence: At this point, the VOC of PM6:BTP-BO-4F:GS-ISO is 0.865 V, the JSC is 27.55 mA cm⁻², and the FF is 78.19%, resulting in the highest PCE of 18.63%.

knowledge_points.content: A hot spin-coating process at 100 °C was employed to overcome the low solubility of organic photovoltaic materials in the nonhalogenated green solvent o-xylene.
knowledge_points.evidence: In order to increase the solubility of O-XY to organic materials and to improve the morphology of the active layer, hot spin-coating is performed at 100 °C in this work.

knowledge_points.content: The addition of 10 wt% GS-ISO to the PM6:BTP-BO-4F host system facilitates the formation of an alloy acceptor model due to the high compatibility between BTP-BO-4F and GS-ISO, indicated by a low interfacial energy of 0.62 mN m⁻¹.
knowledge_points.evidence: The lower interfacial energy between the materials shows that they have good compatibility... the interface energies of BTP-BO-4F/GS-ISO are only 0.62 mN m⁻¹... the relationship between the change in VOC and GS-ISO content shows a linear increase, indicating the formation of an alloy acceptor.

knowledge_points.content: Photoluminescence (PL) quenching and overlapping spectra indicate efficient energy transfer from the GS-ISO acceptor to the BTP-BO-4F host acceptor in the ternary active layer.
knowledge_points.evidence: In the blended film, the emission peak of GS-ISO is fully quenched at 705 nm... indicating the existence of energy transfer from GS-ISO to BTP-BO-4F in the active layer.

knowledge_points.content: Ternary organic solar cells processed in air (50% relative humidity) using o-xylene achieved a power conversion efficiency of 14.13%, which is over 75% of the efficiency achieved in a nitrogen environment.
knowledge_points.evidence: In contrast, the ternary OSCs with 10 wt% GS-ISO content had a VOC of 0.823 V, JSC of 24.49 mA cm⁻², and an FF of 70.09%, resulting in a final efficiency of 14.13%. This efficiency is more than 75% of the efficiency of ternary OSCs (N2).

knowledge_points.content: The introduction of GS-ISO into the PM6:BTP-BO-4F system reduces trap-assisted recombination, as evidenced by the ideality factor (n) decreasing from 1.24 in binary cells to 1.11 in optimized ternary cells.
knowledge_points.evidence: In the VOC · Plight relationship curves, the slopes (n) based on PM6:BTP-BO-4F... are 1.24... whereas the n value for ternary OSCs is 1.11. The lower n values (more closer to 1) indicate that trap-assisted recombination is effectively suppressed.

knowledge_points.content: The optimized ternary blend exhibits more balanced charge transport, with hole and electron mobilities of 5.57 × 10⁻⁴ and 6.94 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ respectively, resulting in a mobility ratio of 1.25.
knowledge_points.evidence: When the GS-ISO content is 10 wt%, both μe and μh reach maximum values of 6.94 × 10⁻⁴ and 5.57 × 10⁻⁴, respectively. And the ratio between μe and μh reaches its minimum value (1.25) at this point.

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS analysis shows that the addition of GS-ISO improves molecular stacking in the active layer, increasing the crystal coherence length (CCL) in the out-of-plane direction to 20.41 Å compared to 17.92 Å for the binary PM6:BTP-BO-4F film.
knowledge_points.evidence: In the OP direction, the π-π stacking distances of PM6:BTP-BO-4F and ternary blended films are 3.70 and 3.64 Å and the CCLs values are 17.92 and 20.41 Å, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The non-radiative voltage loss (ΔVnr) for the ternary OSCs processed in nitrogen was 0.236 V, which increased to 0.246 V for devices fabricated in air, contributing to the lower VOC in air-processed devices.
knowledge_points.evidence: The EQEEL value of ternary OSCs (N2) is 10.1 × 10⁻⁵... higher than that of ternary OSCs (air) (6.67 × 10⁻⁵)... Their corresponding ΔVnr values are 0.236 and 0.246 V, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The ternary OSCs demonstrated enhanced charge extraction and longer carrier lifetimes compared to binary cells, with a charge extraction time (trec) of 1.873 μs and a carrier lifetime (tpho) of 11.596 μs.
knowledge_points.evidence: the charge extraction times (trec) based on PM6:BTP-BO-4F... is higher than the value of the trec based on PM6:BTP-BO-4F:GS-ISO (1.873 us)... the carrier lifetime (tpho) of 11.596 us for the ternary OSCs can be observed through the decay curves in the TPV.
